use crate::Foo;

pub trait Shape {
    fn area(&self) -> f64;
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Foo {
    fn fmt(&self) {}
}

impl Shape for f64 {
    fn area(&self) -> f64 { 1.0 }
}

impl Shape for &Foo {
    fn area(&self) -> f64 { 2.0 }
}

struct Py;

#[pymethods]
impl Py {
    fn exposed(&self) {}
}
